scope: VodBox-managed rebuild path for distributed native artifacts. Records pinned public sources/toolchains for a from-source rebuild that REPLACES opaque upstream prebuilt natives. This is not a claim that any old binary matches any commit.

not_run.note: No build was executed while authoring this path. Output hashes below are null until the main agent runs the scripts and records them.

engine.correction_reason: 15cad005 is the Unicorn1 line (tag 1.0.14) and lacks the bridge-required Control API (uc_ctl_set_cpu_model, uc_ctl_remove_cache, UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX, UC_CPU_ARM_CORTEX_A15). Retargeted to the unicorn2 branch HEAD that provides them. See engine-pin.json.pin_correction. A successful link against this pin proves API completeness for the bridge, NOT that the old prebuilt was built from this exact tree.

artifacts.replaces: unidbg-android:0.9.8 hook libs: libhookzz.so, libwhale.so, libxhook.so (armeabi-v7a + arm64-v8a)
artifacts.abi_compat_check_required: Dobby-vs-HookZz and rebuilt hook runtimes must pass the DEX acceptance suite before substituting; compatibility is not assumed.

artifacts.replaces: unidbg-android:0.9.8 sdk19/lib, sdk23/lib, sdk23/lib64 guest libraries (26 files)
artifacts.fail_closed: Any guest .so without a pinned AOSP tag/module must be dropped from distribution, never shipped unprovenanced.

preserved_compatibility_layer.ipc_contract: unchanged; rebuilt natives are drop-in behind the same JVM-visible com.github.unidbg.arm.backend.unicorn.Unicorn API

gate.closes_when: Every distributed native entry has either an executed VodBox rebuild with a recorded output SHA-256, or is removed from the distribution.
gate.does_not_close_by: Retaining upstream prebuilt natives, or matching a release archive/version string.
